formalCitations.exactSourceText: 悠 can suggest an unhurried manner or something extending far in space or time. In [悠々](../words/悠々.md) ゆうゆう, it is repeated to express a leisurely or composed manner, or doing something easily.
quiz_exclusions: [遠, 久, 永, 楽, 静, 広, 遅, 長, 安, 平, 和, 凪, 休, 息, 寧]

comparisons.reason: Word 悠々 has an "easily; without difficulty" sense (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:140-146); 易 means not difficult (repo/kanji/易.md:20-22).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless at character level: 悠's own character evidence (Daijisen senses evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7-8; JMdict 2844201 evidence/jmdict-families.xml:255-280; KANJIDIC2 evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52-55) has no easy/not-difficult sense; the easily sense is word-level 悠々. Pair not declared on either endpoint; see O1 for an optional defensive exclusion.

comparisons.reason: KANJIDIC2 gives 悠 "permanence" (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52); 常 covers usual, regular, continuing and always (repo/kanji/常.md:20-22).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 悠's extent sense is endless/far-reaching extent in time or space (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7), not regularity or "always"; the eternity overlap is handled by the declared 悠/永 and 悠/久 pairs. Pair 悠/常 not declared on either endpoint; not required.

Harmless: 遊 is play and recreation, enjoying oneself; 悠 is an unhurried manner or far extent (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7-8), and neither card gives a play or leisure-time-activity sense for 悠. Not declared on either endpoint; not required. Shared ユウ reading does not affect the meaning quiz.

comparisons.reason: 優游自適 is a search-only spelling of 悠々自適 (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:13); 優 means kind/gentle and excellent (repo/kanji/優.md:20-22).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: "gentle" is kindness (優しい), not calmness or leisure, and the spelling variant is search-only; 悠 evidence has no kindness or superiority sense. Not declared on either endpoint; not required.

comparisons.reason: 慢 includes a slack or negligent attitude and sluggish pace (repo/kanji/慢.md:33-36); 悠長 glosses include slow and easygoing (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:94-97).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, medium confidence: slackness is negligence or sluggishness, while 悠's character senses are a relaxed, unhurried, composed mood and far extent (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7-8; evidence/jmdict-families.xml:255-280); the slow overlap of each card is handled by its own declared exclusion with 遅. Not declared on either endpoint.

comparisons.reason: Word 悠々 has a "comfortably" gloss (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:140-146); 快 covers pleasant feeling and 快適 comfortable (repo/kanji/快.md:20).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: "comfortably" belongs to the word 悠々's ease sense, not to 悠's character senses (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7-8), and "pleasant; agreeable" names a feeling, not a manner or extent. Not declared on either endpoint; not required.

comparisons.reason: Card Notes say 和 includes peace or calm (snapshot/kanji/悠.md:45).
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: 和 has a harmony or peace sense (repo/kanji/和.md:20-21). The overlap with 悠's calm sense is weak, but 悠 declares the direct pair, a conservative exclusion.

comparisons.reason: Card Notes rely on 休息, rest (snapshot/kanji/悠.md:46).
comparisons.disposition: Already handled, though not semantically required: 息 card confirms the 休息 connection is compound-level and its title is breath (repo/kanji/息.md:20-22). A "breath" option is not a defensible answer for 悠, but 悠 declares the pair; this over-exclusion is harmless.

comparisons.reason: Calm overlap with 悠's calm/quiet sense (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:255-280).
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: 凪 is a lull or calm at sea (repo/kanji/凪.md:23-26), which matches the Notes claim at snapshot/kanji/悠.md:45; 悠 declares the pair.
Already handled and required: 寧 concerns calm, settled peace (repo/kanji/寧.md:23-28), overlapping 悠's quiet/calm sense; declared on 悠, not on 寧.
Already handled and required: 楽 らく means ease or comfortable (repo/kanji/楽.md:20), overlapping Daijisen's relaxed-mood sense (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:8); declared on 悠.
Already handled and required: 遠 describes distance (repo/kanji/遠.md:20-21), and 遠い glosses include distant and remote in time (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:316-330); declared on 悠.
Already handled and required: 久 points to a long stretch of time (repo/kanji/久.md:20); declared on 悠.
Already handled and required: 永 concerns eternity or permanence (repo/kanji/永.md:20); declared on 悠.

comparisons.reason: Card Notes link 広 to the boundless sense (snapshot/kanji/悠.md:46).
comparisons.disposition: Already handled, conservative: 広 concerns width, space or spreading (repo/kanji/広.md:20), with only partial overlap with "boundless" extent; declared on 悠.

comparisons.reason: Slowness overlap: 悠長 slow, leisurely (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:94-97).
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: 遅 covers lateness and slowness (repo/kanji/遅.md:20-21); "slow" is plausibly confused with "leisurely", and 悠 declares the pair.
